GOAL: orient in the workspace before committing to a curvature mechanism.
READ: listed the workspace root (no files read yet other than a directory listing).
OBSERVED: this session exposes only read/list/append_progress; the deliverable is a plain-text IDEA block printed in the reply.
REASONING: the round demands a curvature mechanism that (a) is NOT a distance-only change (a monotone transform of Euclidean distance cannot change an argmin, which explains why six curved arms produced nothing measurable), (b) puts the training-only behaviour signal and the curved operation in ONE argmin equation, (c) has a c->0 limit that reproduces the baseline Euclidean RQ-VAE so the geometry switch is exact, and (d) uses no tuned constant.
STILL OPEN: final numeric spec (shapes, recursion, safeguards) and the novelty argument against the 15 rejected mechanisms.

GOAL: rule out mechanism families that cannot work, and pick a curvature position that is measurably different.
READ: nothing further in the workspace (only progress.jsonl); used the round's recorded facts instead.
OBSERVED / DERIVED: (1) Key negative result: d_P(p,q) is a strictly monotone function of g = ||p-q||^2 / ((1-||p||^2)(1-||q||^2)). If all codewords sit at one common radius, ranking by d_P from the ORIGIN-anchored point equals ranking by Euclidean residual, so a curvature-only distance change leaves the discrete assignment invariant -> explains why the six curved arms were at noise. Curvature can only change SIDs if (i) codeword norms are heterogeneous (then the denominator 1-||c_k||^2 reorders candidates), (ii) the composition of the residual chain is non-commutative (Moebius addition) so P_{l-1} != 0 re-anchors deeper levels, or (iii) curvature enters a constraint/mass term rather than a distance.
(2) Chosen position (different from the three example positions and from all 15 rejected ones): curvature in the COMPOSITION + hyperbolic shell-volume behaviour prior, inside the same argmax. Behaviour signal = training-only directed-transition mass (out-degree damped) aggregated into per-level prefix mass n_k; geometry = Moebius composition distance with c=1 and the sinh^2 shell-volume factor. Prior coefficient is exactly 1 (it is a log-probability), Laplace smoothing is add-one, scale s is a measured EMA RMS -> no tuned constant; c->0 reproduces baseline RQ-VAE exactly (exp_0->id, oplus->+, sinh(sqrt(c)rho)/sqrt(c)rho->1, V->1).
STILL OPEN: writing the full self-contained signature (shapes, recursion, STE, freeze-at-encoding rule, safeguards).

GOAL: deliver the complete, self-contained proposal as the final record.
READ: nothing (workspace has only progress.jsonl).
OBSERVED / REASONING: finalised MOEBIUS-MASS-RQ. Curvature appears twice in ONE argmax: (a) the candidate point is the Moebius composition P_{l-1} (+) c_hat_k, whose distance is NOT a monotone reparametrisation of the Euclidean residual once codeword radii are heterogeneous and P_{l-1} != 0 (this is the exact reason the earlier curved distance-only arms could not flip any token), and (b) the codeword prior is divided by the hyperbolic shell-volume factor sinh^2(rho)/rho^2, normalised to mean 1. The training-only behaviour signal is the damped directed-transition mass of items aggregated per level into n_{l,k}, entering as an add-one-smoothed log-probability with coefficient exactly 1 (no tuned weight). c = 1 with a measured EMA RMS scale s makes the curvature unit-free; c -> 0 reproduces the baseline Euclidean RQ-VAE exactly (identity exp map, + instead of (+), V -> 1), giving an exact geometry switch. Cost ~1e1% of Stage2 step time.
STILL OPEN: nothing; the answer below is complete and stands alone.
ANSWER:
IDEA: MOEBIUS-MASS-RQ
TITLE: Moebius-composed residual quantization with a hyperbolic shell-volume behaviour-mass prior
MOTIVATION: RQ-VAE Semantic IDs are produced by a Euclidean greedy residual chain whose codebook cells are wildly uneven in the behaviour mass they carry. Tokens that no training transition ever routes through consume steps of the generative prefix (wasted beam search), while a few tokens carry most of the traffic and their conditional distributions in Stage3 are hard to predict. Behaviour-only prefix changes gave about +0.013 Recall; a curvature-only distance change gave nothing, because a monotone reparametrisation of Euclidean distance cannot change an argmin. This idea makes curvature change the discrete token decisions themselves, and makes the behaviour mass per token equal in curved-volume terms.
NOVELTY: Not a distance, a regulariser, a codebook centroid rule, a radius/entropy assignment, a transport/warp, a cohort parent, a per-level feedback curvature, a barycentre or a tangent quantizer. Curvature enters as (i) NON-COMMUTATIVE COMPOSITION of the residual chain (Moebius addition: the level-l candidate point is P_{l-1} (+) c_hat_k, so the level-l metric depends on the prefix and curvature stops being a monotone reparametrisation of the Euclidean residual once codeword radii differ, which is precisely the invariant that killed the earlier curved arms), and (ii) a HYPERBOLIC SHELL-VOLUME divisor sinh^2(rho_k)/rho_k^2 on a training-only behaviour-mass prior, inside the same argmax as (i). Behaviour is a per-level prefix mass, not a successor direction, not an entropy, not a co-occurrence rank.
CHANGE: The Euclidean residual argmin is replaced by one scored argmax over the Moebius composition distance to the running prefix point, plus the log of a behaviour prefix mass divided by the hyperbolic shell volume at that codeword's radius. Geometry and behaviour meet in a single scalar score per (item, level, codeword); dropping either removes half of that score.
SPECIFICATION:
Fixed: L=3 levels, K codewords per level, latent width d, base curvature c=1 (units fixed by the measured scale s), commit weight beta_c=0.25 (inherited from the existing RQ-VAE config, unchanged). Trainable: tangent-space codebooks U in R^{L x K x d}; encoder E and decoder D unchanged.
Measured, never tuned: s = EMA (de

cay 0.99, detached) of the batch RMS of ||z_i||_2 over training items only; c=1 is made unit-free by dividing z by s, so the typical radius is tanh(1) = 0.76 inside the unit ball.
Poincare tools with c=1 (all per vector, eps=1e-8): exp0(v) = tanh(||v||) v/||v||; log0(p) = artanh(||p||) p/||p||; Mobius add p(+)q = ((1+2<p,q>+||q||^2) p + (1-||p||^2) q) / (1+2<p,q>+||p||^2||q||^2); inversion (-)p = -p; dP(p,q) = 2 artanh(||(-p)(+)q||).
Behaviour, training split only: for each train item i, m_i = 1 + log1p(outdeg_i) where outdeg_i is the number of directed transitions i->j in the training sequences; at the end of every epoch (torch.no_grad, detached) recompute the per-level prefix mass n[l,k] = sum_{i: token_l(i)=k} m_i / sum_i m_i over training items, initialised to 1/K; frozen at the end of Stage 2 for the final encoding pass.
Derived prior (add-one smoothing toward uniform, coefficient exactly 1 because it is a log-probability): prior[l,k] = (n[l,k] + 1/K) / 2, so sum_k prior[l,k] = 1. Shell volume: rho[l,k] = dP(0, c_hat[l,k]); g[l,k] = sinh(rho[l,k])^2 / rho[l,k]^2 (=1 at rho=0, series for rho<1e-3); Vhat[l,k] = g[l,k] / mean_{k'} g[l,k'].
Per batch: v_i = z_i/s; p_i = exp0(v_i); c_hat[l,k] = exp0(U[l,k]); P_i <- 0; for l=1..L: Q[i,k] = P_i (+) c_hat[l,k]; score[i,k] = -dP(p_i, Q[i,k])^2/(2 s^2) + log(prior[l,k]/Vhat[l,k]); k*_i = argmax_k score[i,k] (straight-through: P_i <- Q[i,k*_i] carrying the gradient into U[l,k*_i]); token_l(i) = k*_i. Reconstruct v_hat_i = log0(P_i), z_hat_i = s v_hat_i. Loss = mean_i ||v_i - v_hat_i||^2 + beta_c * mean_{i,l} ||r_i^l/s - U[l,k*_i]||^2 with curved residual r_i^l = log0( (-)P_{l-1}(i) (+) p_i ) and the residual path detached as in the baseline.
COST: One run only (3000 Stage 2 epochs x 24 steps = 72,000 steps on four cards) plus the frozen Stage 3. Per step, with B items per batch, the new work is B*L*K Mobius additions and distances plus one B*L*K*? score tensor: at B=1024, K=256, L=3 that is 786,432 Mobius+distance evaluations, about 40 MFLOP and a 1024x256x3 score tensor; measured overhead expectation 8-12% of Stage 2 step time (tens of minutes over the whole run). The epoch-end n-table update is one pass over the train items (24,556 items), negligible. Stage 3 cost unchanged (same three-token SID format), and there is no extra inference pass and no extra memory beyond a few K-vectors per level.
HYPOTHESIS: For the idea to be worth keeping, the single coupled run must (a) actually flip tokens relative to the Euclidean codebook (recorded diagnostic: fraction of train items whose level-1 token changes vs the geometry-off rule, expected 10-30%), (b) raise the normalised entropy of the per-level behaviour mass n[l,:] toward log K, and (c) lift Stage 3 test_recall@10 above 0.065 versus the official baseline 0.0410 and the behaviour-prefix band 0.0525-0.0540. If token flips occur but the mass stays concentrated, the volume divisor is mis-scaled; if no flips occur at all, the codeword radii have homogenised and the mechanism is back to a monotone distance.
RISKS: The behaviour prior term can dominate early and starve semantically meaningful codewords; the volume divisor can push all heavy items onto origin-near codewords and collapse effective capacity; Mobius/artanh saturation can produce NaN or exploding gradients near the ball boundary; the straight-through composition makes the reconstruction gradient path longer and can slow Stage 2 convergence on the frozen budget; a single seed may land in a

bad basin with no repetition allowed; and the mass-balancing may improve behaviour balance without improving the generative model's predictability, in which case Recall stays near the behaviour-only band.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Training-only directed item-transition mass, damped: m_i = 1 + log1p(outdeg_i) over the training sequences, aggregated per RQ level into the prefix mass vector n[l,k].
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: Built once from the training split's ordered item sequences by counting directed pairs (i -> next item) inside each sequence, giving outdeg_i per item; then, at the end of each Stage 2 epoch, every training item is passed through the current encoder and the current argmax rule and its mass m_i is accumulated into n[l, token_l(i)] for l=1..3, normalised to sum 1 and detached. No validation and no test sequence, item, or timestamp is read.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: The SID construction sees only training sequences (for outdeg) and training items (for the encoder forward that fills n). Validation/test interactions never enter m_i, n[l,k], s, or the final frozen assignment; the n table and s are frozen before the final encoding pass, and the encoding pass uses only the item's own features plus these frozen training-derived statistics, so no future co-consumption can leak into a token.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Fixed negative curvature c = 1 in the Poincare ball (unit-free because the latent is divided by the measured scale s): the Mobius addition p(+)q used to compose the codeword chain, the induced Poincare distance dP(p,q) = 2 artanh(||(-p)(+)q||), and the hyperbolic shell-volume factor sinh(sqrt(c) rho)^2/(c rho^2) at each codeword's radius rho.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: Inside Stage 2 quantization, at every RQ level: the candidate point for level l is a Moebius composition of the already-chosen prefix with codeword k, the score uses the Poincare distance to that composition, and the codeword prior is divided by the shell volume at the codeword's own radius. Nothing is added beside the quantizer; the encoder and decoder are untouched.
COUPLING PATH: One scalar score per (item, level, codeword) contains both terms: score[i,k] = -dP(p_i, P_{l-1}(i)(+)c_hat_k)^2 / (2 s^2) + log(prior[l,k]/Vhat[l,k]). The argmax that emits the token consumes both; the token feeds the next level's prefix point P_l (which re-anchors the curved distance) and the next epoch's n table (which rebuilds the prior). Removing behaviour sets prior/Vhat to 1 and changes the argmax; removing curvature sets c->0 so that exp0 is the identity, (+) is +, dP is the Euclidean norm and Vhat is 1, and again changes the argmax.
COUPLING EQUATION: k*_l(i) = argmax_k [ -dP( p_i , P_{l-1}(i) (+) c_hat_{l,k} )^2 / (2 s^2) + log( prior_{l,k}^{behaviour} / Vhat_{l,k}^{hyperbolic}(c) ) ], with prior_{l,k} = (n_{l,k}+1/K)/2, n_{l,k} from training transitions, Vhat_{l,k} = [sinh(sqrt(c) rho_{l,k})^2/(c rho_{l,k}^2)] normalised to mean 1, and P_l = P_{l-1} (+) c_hat_{l,k*}.
OBSERVABLES: Token flip rate per level versus the geometry-off rule (diagnostic, not a gate); normalised entropy of n[l,:] per level; the distribution of codeword radii rho and of per-prefix behaviour mass; the fraction of items whose deepest residual exceeds the ball-safe radius (must be 0); Stage 3 prefix-prediction transfer diagnostics (recorded only); and the judgement quantity, Stage 3 test_recall@10.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: prior_{l,k}/Vhat_{l,k} is replaced by 1, i.e. the score is the pure curved-composition nearest-neighbour,

with the Moebius composition and Poincare distance unchanged; the n table is still computed but unused. Code path gated by BEHAVIOUR_ON=False; not trained in this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: c is driven to the Euclidean limit (exp0 = identity, (+) = vector addition, dP = ||.||, sinh(sqrt(c)rho)^2/(c rho^2) -> 1), which reduces the model exactly to a baseline Euclidean RQ-VAE carrying the behaviour prefix prior. Code path gated by GEOMETRY_ON=False; not trained in this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: The full coupled run, BEHAVIOUR_ON=True and GEOMETRY_ON=True, c=1, behaviour prior divided by the shell volume; this is the one and only trained arm of the round.
SPEC EQUATIONS:
Constants: L=3, K, d, c=1, beta_c=0.25, eps=1e-8, EMA decay 0.99. Parameters: U in R^{L,K,d}; encoder E: x -> R^d; decoder D: R^d -> x.
Measured: s = EMA_rms(||E(x)||) over training items, detached.
Behaviour data: outdeg_i from training sequences; m_i = 1+log1p(outdeg_i); n in R^{L,K}, init 1/K.
Per codeword: c_hat_{l,k} = exp0_c(U[l,k]) = tanh(sqrt(c)||U||) U/(sqrt(c)||U||); rho_{l,k} = dP(0,c_hat) = (2/sqrt(c)) artanh(sqrt(c)||c_hat||); g = sinh(sqrt(c)rho)^2/(c rho^2); Vhat = g / mean_k(g).
Prior: prior_{l,k} = (n_{l,k} + 1/K)/2 ; assert sum_k prior = 1.
Per item: v = E(x)/s ; p = exp0_c(v) ; P_0 = 0.
For l = 1..L:
  Q_{l,k} = P_{l-1} (+) c_hat_{l,k}, Mobius: (A p + B q)/C with p=P, q=c_hat, A = 1 + 2c<p,q> + c^2||q||^2, B = 1 - c||p||^2, C = 1 + 2c<p,q> + c^2||p||^2||q||^2 (clamp C >= eps).
  dist2_{l,k} = dP(p, Q_{l,k})^2 = (4/c) artanh(sqrt(c)||(-p)(+)Q||)^2, clamp argument <= 1-eps.
  score_{l,k} = -dist2_{l,k}/(2 s^2) + log(prior_{l,k}) - log(Vhat_{l,k}).
  k*_l = argmax_k score_{l,k}; token_l = k*_l.
  P_l = stop_grad_select(Q_{l,k*_l}) + (Q_{l,k*_l} - stop_grad_select(Q_{l,k*_l}))   [straight-through: forward value Q, gradient flows into U[l,k*_l] and into P_{l-1}].
Reconstruction: v_hat = log0_c(P_L) = (1/sqrt(c)) artanh(sqrt(c)||P_L||) P_L/(||P_L||); z_hat = s v_hat.
Curved residual for commit: r_l = log0_c( (-P_{l-1}) (+) p ), detached.
Loss = mean ||v - v_hat||^2 + beta_c * mean_{i,l} || stop_grad(r_l)/s - U[l,k*_l] ||^2.
Epoch end (no_grad, training items only): zero n; for each train item accumulate m_i into n[l, token_l(i)]; renormalise to sum 1 per level; keep the previous table if it is the first epoch.
Output: three token ids per item, plus the frozen (s, n, U, E) used for the final encoding pass.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: a batch of item features x (B x d_x), the tangent codebooks U (L x K x d), the measured scale s (scalar), the frozen behaviour table n (L x K), the curvature c (scalar), the two switches BEHAVIOUR_ON and GEOMETRY_ON. Outputs: token ids t (B x L) integer, prefix points P_l (B x d) on the Poincare ball, the reconstruction v_hat (B x d) / z_hat, the scalar loss, and the epoch-end n update. Encoding-only call returns t and P_L.
SAFEGUARDS: Divide by s (a measured positive scalar, clamped to >= eps) so that ||v|| <= 8 by construction and no point can reach the ball boundary; clamp the artanh argument to <= 1-1e-6 and the Mobius denominator C to >= 1e-6; use the series g = 1 + (c rho^2)/3 for rho < 1e-3 to avoid 0/0; initialise U small (||U|| ~ 0.1) so every c_hat starts near the origin; Laplace smoothing (n+1/K)/2 and the normalised Vhat keep both log terms finite and O(1) and prevent empty-codeword divergence; if any score, distance or loss component is non-finite, the step falls back to the Euclidean branch for that batch and is lo

gged; the n table is detached, renormalised and never back-propagated; the EMA scale s is frozen at the end of Stage 2 so the final encoding pass is deterministic; the two switches are single flags read at the top of the score function so the geometry-off and behaviour-off code paths are the exact limits described above.
END IDEA

IDEA: MOEBIUS-MASS-RQ
TITLE: Moebius-composed residual quantization with a hyperbolic shell-volume behaviour-mass prior
MOTIVATION: RQ-VAE Semantic IDs come from a Euclidean greedy residual chain whose codebook cells are wildly uneven in the behaviour mass they carry: some tokens absorb most of the training transitions (hard for Stage3 to predict), others absorb almost none (wasted beam-search steps). Behaviour-only prefix changes reached about +0.013 Recall, while curvature-only distance changes reached nothing, because a monotone reparametrisation of Euclidean distance cannot change an argmin. This idea makes curvature change the discrete token decisions themselves and makes behaviour mass per token equal in curved-volume terms.
NOVELTY: Not a distance, a regulariser, a centroid rule, a radius/entropy assignment, a transport/warp, a cohort parent, a per-level feedback curvature, a barycentre or a tangent quantizer. Curvature enters as (i) NON-COMMUTATIVE COMPOSITION of the residual chain (the level-l candidate point is P_{l-1} (+) c_hat_k, so the level-l metric depends on the prefix and curvature stops being a monotone reparametrisation of the Euclidean residual once codeword radii differ - exactly the invariant that killed the earlier curved arms) and (ii) a HYPERBOLIC SHELL-VOLUME divisor sinh^2(rho)/rho^2 on a training-only behaviour-mass prior, inside the same argmax.
CHANGE: The Euclidean residual argmin is replaced by one scored argmax over the Moebius composition distance to the running prefix point plus the log of a behaviour prefix mass divided by the hyperbolic shell volume at that codeword's radius. Geometry and behaviour meet in a single scalar score per (item, level, codeword); dropping either removes half of that score.
SPECIFICATION: Fixed L=3, K codewords, width d, c=1 (unit-free via the measured scale s), beta_c=0.25 (inherited, unchanged). Trainable tangent codebooks U in R^{L,K,d}. Measured: s = EMA(0.99, detached) batch RMS of ||z|| over training items. Poincare tools (c=1): exp0(v)=tanh(||v||)v/||v||; log0(p)=artanh(||p||)p/||p||; p(+)q=((1+2<p,q>+||q||^2)p+(1-||p||^2)q)/(1+2<p,q>+||p||^2||q||^2); dP(p,q)=2artanh(||(-p)(+)q||). Behaviour: m_i = 1+log1p(outdeg_i) on training sequences; epoch-end detached per-level prefix mass n[l,k]; prior[l,k]=(n[l,k]+1/K)/2. Shell volume g[l,k]=sinh(rho)^2/rho^2 with Vhat normalised to mean 1. Per batch: v=z/s, p=exp0(v), P<-0; for l=1..3: Q_k=P(+)c_hat_k, score_k = -dP(p,Q_k)^2/(2s^2)+log(prior_k/Vhat_k), k*=argmax (straight-through into U), P<-Q_{k*}. Reconstruct v_hat=log0(P), loss = mean||v-v_hat||^2 + beta_c*mean||r_l/s - U[l,k*]||^2 with curved residual r_l=log0((-P_{l-1})(+)p).
COST: One run (3000 epochs x 24 steps = 72,000 steps, four cards) plus frozen Stage3. Per step at B=1024, K=256, L=3: 786,432 Moebius+distance evaluations, about 40 MFLOP and a 1024x256x3 score tensor, expected 8-12% of Stage2 step time; epoch-end n update is one pass over 24,556 train items; Stage3 unchanged (same three-token format), no extra inference pass.
HYPOTHESIS: The single coupled run must flip tokens versus the geometry-off rule (recorded diagnostic, expected 10-30% at level 1), raise the normalised entropy of n[l,:] toward log K, and lift Stage3 test_recall@10 above 0.065 versus the official 0.0410 baseline and the 0.0525-0.0540 behaviour band.

and collapse capacity; artanh/Mobius saturation can produce NaN near the boundary; the straight-through composition lengthens the reconstruction gradient path and can slow convergence on the frozen budget; one seed may land in a bad basin; mass balance may not translate into Stage3 predictability.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Training-only directed item-transition mass m_i = 1+log1p(outdeg_i), aggregated per RQ level into the prefix mass vector n[l,k].
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: Count directed pairs (item -> next item) inside training-split sequences to get outdeg_i; at every Stage2 epoch end, encode each training item, take its current token at each level, accumulate m_i into n[l, token_l(i)], renormalise to sum 1, detached. No validation or test sequence is read.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: SID construction sees only training sequences (outdeg) and training items (encoder forward filling n). Validation/test interactions never enter m_i, n, s or the frozen assignment; n and s are frozen before the final encoding pass, which uses only an item's own features plus training-derived statistics.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Fixed negative curvature c=1 in the Poincare ball (unit-free after dividing the latent by s): Mobius addition composing the codeword chain, the induced Poincare distance dP(p,q)=2artanh(||(-p)(+)q||), and the shell-volume factor sinh(sqrt(c)rho)^2/(c rho^2) at each codeword radius.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: Inside Stage2 quantization at every RQ level: the candidate point is a Moebius composition of the chosen prefix with the codeword, the score uses the Poincare distance to that composition, and the codeword prior is divided by the shell volume at the codeword's radius. Encoder and decoder untouched.
COUPLING PATH: One scalar score per (item, level, codeword) carries both terms; the argmax emits the token, which re-anchors the next level's prefix point P_l (changing the curved distance) and rebuilds next epoch's n table (changing the prior). Removing behaviour sets prior/Vhat to 1; removing curvature sets c->0 so exp0=id, (+)=+, dP=||.||, Vhat=1.
COUPLING EQUATION: k*_l(i) = argmax_k [ -dP( p_i , P_{l-1}(i) (+) c_hat_{l,k} )^2/(2 s^2) + log( prior_{l,k}^{behaviour} / Vhat_{l,k}^{hyperbolic}(c) ) ], prior_{l,k}=(n_{l,k}+1/K)/2, Vhat normalised shell volume, P_l = P_{l-1}(+)c_hat_{l,k*}.
OBSERVABLES: Per-level token flip rate versus the geometry-off rule; normalised entropy of n[l,:]; distribution of codeword radii and per-prefix behaviour mass; fraction of items outside the ball-safe radius (must be 0); Stage3 prefix-transfer diagnostics recorded only; and Stage3 test_recall@10 as the judgement.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: prior/Vhat := 1, i.e. pure curved-composition nearest neighbour with Mobius composition and dP unchanged; n still computed but unused; flag BEHAVIOUR_ON=False, not trained this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: c->0 exact limit (exp0=id, (+)=+, dP=||.||, Vhat=1), reducing the model exactly to a baseline Euclidean RQ-VAE carrying the behaviour prefix prior; flag GEOMETRY_ON=False, not trained this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: The full coupled run, BEHAVIOUR_ON=True and GEOMETRY_ON=True, c=1, prior divided by the shell volume; the only trained arm.
SPEC EQUATIONS: c_hat=exp0_c(U); rho=(2/sqrt(c))artanh(sqrt(c)||c_hat||); g=sinh(sqrt(c)rho)^2/(c rho^2) (series 1+c rho^2/3 for rho<1e-3); Vhat=g/mean_k(g); prior=(n+1/K)/2 with sum_k prior=1; v=E(x)/s; p=exp0_c(v); P_0=0; for l=1..L: Q_{l,k}=P_{l-1}(+)c_hat_{l,k} with A=1+2c<P,q>+c^2||q||^2, B=1-c||P||^2, C=1+2

c<P,q>+c^2||P||^2||q||^2 (C clamped >= eps); dist2=(4/c)artanh(sqrt(c)||(-p)(+)Q||)^2 (arg clamped <= 1-eps); score=-dist2/(2s^2)+log prior-log Vhat; k*=argmax score; P_l=Q_{l,k*} with straight-through (forward value Q, gradient into U[l,k*] and P_{l-1}); v_hat=log0_c(P_L); r_l=log0_c((-P_{l-1})(+)p) detached; Loss=mean||v-v_hat||^2+beta_c*mean||r_l/s-U[l,k*]||^2; epoch end: zero n, accumulate m_i into n[l,token_l(i)] over training items, renormalise.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: item batch x (B x d_x), U (L x K x d), scalar s, n (L x K), scalar c, switches BEHAVIOUR_ON / GEOMETRY_ON. Outputs: token ids t (B x L) int, prefix points P_l (B x d) on the ball, v_hat / z_hat, scalar loss, epoch-end n update; encoding-only call returns t and P_L.
SAFEGUARDS: divide by clamped s so ||v|| <= 8 and no point reaches the boundary; clamp artanh argument <= 1-1e-6 and Mobius denominator >= 1e-6; series for g near rho=0; init ||U|| ~ 0.1 so all c_hat start near the origin; add-one smoothing and normalised Vhat keep log terms finite and O(1) and handle empty codewords; on any non-finite score/distance/loss the batch falls back to the Euclidean branch and is logged; n is detached, renormalised, never back-propagated; s frozen at Stage2 end for a deterministic encoding pass; both switches are single flags read at the top of the score function so the off-paths are the exact stated limits.
